ar.title: بتي فور تشيكي

steps.n1: يضرب في المضرب الزبد والسكر والبيض وجوز الهند والفانيليا، ثم يضاف للخليط الدقيق الممزوج بالبيكنج باودر.
steps.n3: تقطع العجينة دوائر صغيرة مثل الكور وبحجم ليمونة كبيرة.
steps.n4: تدهن الصينية بالزيت وتوضع بها الكور على مسافات بعيدة.
steps.n5: تدخل فرن متوسط الحرارة حتى النضج.
steps.n6: بعد خروجها مباشرة تسقى بالشراب بالملعقة.
steps.n7: يمكن أيضا أن تدهن كل واحدة بقليل من الشيكولاته السايحة وفوقها البندق المفري.

en.title: Cheeky Petit Four

steps.n1: Cream the butter, sugar, egg, coconut, and vanilla in a mixer, then add the flour mixed with the baking powder.
steps.n2: Let the dough rest for 10 minutes.
steps.n3: Shape the dough into small spheres, roughly the size of a large lemon.
steps.n4: Grease a baking tray with oil and place the spheres on it, leaving plenty of space between them.
steps.n5: Bake in a medium-heat oven until golden and cooked through.
steps.n6: Immediately after removing from the oven, drizzle each piece with simple syrup using a spoon.
steps.n7: You can also drizzle each piece with melted chocolate and top with crushed hazelnuts.

legacySteps: Cream the butter, sugar, egg, coconut, and vanilla in a mixer, then add the flour mixed with the baking powder.
Let the dough rest for 10 minutes.
Shape the dough into small spheres, roughly the size of a large lemon.
Grease a baking tray with oil and place the spheres on it, leaving plenty of space between them.
Bake in a medium-heat oven until golden and cooked through.
Immediately after removing from the oven, drizzle each piece with simple syrup using a spoon.
You can also drizzle each piece with melted chocolate and top with crushed hazelnuts.
